name: tovu-deploy-fly
description: Deploys a Tovu instance to fly.io with no CLI installed anywhere — a fly.toml and a GitHub Actions workflow go into the operator's repo and the workflow is fired through the workspace's saved GitHub credential, so flyctl only ever runs on GitHub's runner. Encodes the Tovu-and-fly-specific rules generic fly.io knowledge gets wrong: exactly one machine (SQLite), the volume shadowing the image's entire sites/ tree, secrets never in fly.toml, the sealed-credential master key, and deploying shipping code rather than content. Every GitHub step it needs — writing the files, the repository secret, the dispatch, following the run — belongs to the separate bundled 'github' plugin and is deliberately not repeated here.
author: Tovu
